title: PERSPECTRA: A SCALABLE AND CONFIGURABLE PLURALIST BENCHMARK OF PERSPECTIVES FROM ARGUMENTS

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates models' capacity for pluralism (and conversely, their bias towards homogenized, majority perspectives) by testing them on three tasks: opinion counting (estimating the number of distinct viewpoints in a text), opinion matching (aligning expanded arguments to their original source claims), and polarity check (inferring aggregate pro/con stances from mixed discourse).
